notes: The no-policy coding (`missing`) does not apply: the usable sources include governing leave documents (HOP V Ch. 15, 17, 18; Regents' Rule 30201; HOP III 4.9) and state birth, adoption and pregnancy provisions.

Documents and versions: HOP III 4.9 in 2018_01 (2015) is superseded by 2018_07 (Nov 4, 2016); 4.4.1.1 and 4.4.1.5 of 2018_01 are read as in force on the reference date per the document's version note (no dated revision of 4.4 between 2015 and 2021). 2018_00_link is an undated HR summary captured after the reference date; it is subordinate to the governing documents (source precedence).

No institutional paid parental, maternity or childbirth leave, modified duties or teaching relief appears in any saved source. The only birth-specific leave is FMLA (c1). Regents' Rule 30201 Sec. 6 parental leave (Tex. Gov't Code 661.913, up to 12 weeks, for employees not eligible for FMLA) is recorded in c1's note under U8, not as a component. Pregnancy appears only as a permitted use of accrued sick leave ('pregnancy and confinement', c2).

Not components (cannot be used for a birth or adoption): jury duty, holidays, travel, military leave, bereavement, educational-activities use of sick leave (8 hours for children's school activities), development leave (Tex. Educ. Code 51.101), organ, marrow and blood donor leave, short absences for personal business requiring approval (HOP III 4.9.2).

Documents cited but not saved: HOP Section V parental leave chapter (HOP III 4.9.9, 4.9.7.4); HOP Section V Chapter 16 (University Sick Leave Pool), Sick Leave Pool Policy and Sick Leave Pool Donation Program; HOP Section V Chapter 22 (military leave); Military Leave Policy; Bereavement Leave Policy; Vacation Leave Policy; Educational Activities Policy 15.4 (its text is HOP V 15.4, saved); HOP Section V Chapters 4.2, 7 and 29; HOP Section II (student affairs); Regents' Rules 10501, 20801, 30103, 30104, 31001, 31002, 31003, 31004, 31006, 31008, 31102; Texas Government Code 661.913 and 661.911 and the other statutes listed under C4.

Chain, birth parent: FMLA 12 weeks (c1), with accrued sick leave (c2) substituted within it, then the Sick Leave Pool (c3) after all paid leave is exhausted; general-purpose leave without pay (c4) may follow FMLA (not counted).

Chain, non-birth parent: FMLA 12 weeks (c1), with accrued sick leave (c2, family-care use) within it, then the Sick Leave Pool (c3); general-purpose leave without pay (c4) may follow FMLA (not counted).

Calendar: the faculty handbook refers to semesters and 'long semester' (HOP III 4.8.2, 4.15.5); kind of term stated without its length, so calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order. No component uses a term unit.
